lines.text: Many learners say: I attached my curriculum to the email.
Better: I attached my resume to the email.
Your paper for a job is a resume.
The second! I need a resume for the job.

data.wrong: I attached my curriculum to the email.
data.right: I attached my resume to the email.
data.why: Your paper for a job is a resume.

quiz.stem: I need a ___ for the job.

native.tip: Em português “currículo” é o documento para pedir emprego; em inglês, ele é o “resume”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “I attached my curriculum to the email.” O certo é “I attached my resume to the email.” Em português “currículo” é o documento para pedir emprego; em inglês, ele é o “resume”. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.

en.tip: In Portuguese “currículo” is the paper you send for a job; in English, it is a “resume”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I attached my curriculum to the email.” The right way is “I attached my resume to the email.” In Portuguese “currículo” is the paper you send for a job; in English, it is a “resume”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
